items.title: Can I order before the shop opens?
items.body: No. Lot One is cut in a single run and every piece goes to the list in the order names came in. Adding your name is the whole queue.

items.title: Do you cut for left hands?
items.body: Yes. Say so when you order and the qatt is reversed. There is no extra charge and no extra wait.

items.title: How long does a reed pen last?
items.body: A season of daily practice, then it wants re-cutting. We send a qat'ah with every pen and instructions for the second cut.

items.title: Do you ship outside the country?
items.body: Not for Lot One. Ink is a problem at customs and we would rather solve it properly than lose your parcel.
